notes:
Version 3.1.2 adds more Norwegian pay agreements and a guided agreement setup. Open a job's pay settings, choose an agreement, and complete the relevant category, seniority, qualification or work-week choices. The available choices depend on the agreement. Rates, supplements and overtime coverage can be inspected in the pay editor. Some agreements require manual overtime or employer-specific input; the app displays those limits.

Existing saved wage snapshots are not automatically migrated. Unfinished agreement selections and personal pay settings are preserved when switching pay sources. Friends and shared schedules remain available to older app versions; earnings that require newer pay rules are withheld from incompatible clients.

Sign in using the demo account credentials supplied in App Review Information. This account does not require a new-device email code. The demo jobs Harbor Café and City Library use USD intentionally, even on a Norwegian device.

You can add and edit shifts, inspect estimated earnings and pay settings, and use the shared calendar and messaging screens with the demo account.

Tidex is free and has no in-app purchases.
